## Projects

### High-Performance Portfolio
- Tech: HTML, CSS, Web Optimization
- Architected a zero-dependency, single-file portfolio site with all CSS inlined, served from a static edge cache.
- Engineered a completely static, JavaScript-free architecture: no third-party requests and no runtime dependencies, which keeps the attack surface limited to the hosting provider and the origin configuration.
- A Content-Security-Policy of `default-src 'none'` is served, making script execution structurally unreachable.

### AI Advertisement Tool (RAG Pipeline)
- Tech: Python, RAG, ETL
- Developed an end-to-end content engine using a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework to synthesize data from LinkedIn, GitHub, and web portfolios.
- Architected an ETL pipeline to clean unstructured web data for LLM-based script generation and automated video/audio synthesis.

### Temporal RAG Pipeline
- Tech: Python, RAG, ETL
- Developed an end-to-end pipeline where you can input a video, and make any query regarding it.
- Worked with advanced data structures and various audio-video technologies to produce a system capable of answering queries about a video based on timeline and not only semantical similarity.

### Keryx
- Tech: Rust, ed25519, IPC, agent security
- Local signed message bus where every message carries an ed25519 signature verified by a daemon (keryxd) against the key registered for the claimed name in config.toml.
- A wrapper holds the key and signs via a private relay socket so a prompt-injected agent cannot impersonate another identity; relay requests carry no sender or signature fields and the daemon uses verify_strict with no trust-on-first-use.
- Length-prefixed canonical bytes with domain separation, per-identity monotonic sequence numbers for posts and timestamp+nonce for reads, and provenance enforcement including force_external.
- Repository: https://github.com/natarmr/keryx — Blog: https://blogs.ramratan.in/keryx/

### GrandTribunal
- Tech: Python, Gradio, Nemotron, VoxCPM
-Shipped an Ace Attorney-style turn-based AI debate game utilizing voice input for an immersive, hands-free
player experience. Trained and deployed two specialized Nemotron models on character personality datasets to
serve as dynamic opponents and logical judges, interfaced through a custom Gradio frontend.

### Independent Research on BitNet-1.58b
- Tech: Python, Machine Learning, Mathematics
- Conducting novel research and experimentation on BitNet-1.58b by altering its context length.

### ARGUS
- Tech: Python, Gemma 4, IoT Simulation
-  Simulated a drone swarm that collectively maps any terrain using Gemma 4 31B vision via Cerebras.
- Engineered autonomous agent drones sharing a collective memory that aggregates into a unified semantic map
   displayed on a CesiumJS 3D globe.
- Used Gemma 4 inference to classify areas on the terrain, map traffic congregation spots
- Worked with FastAPI to serve as the backend for the simulation
